title: LLMs Cannot Reliably Identify and Reason About Security Vulnerabilities (Yet?): A Comprehensive Evaluation, Framework, and Benchmarks

bias_targets.target: Lexical and semantic code bias (Function and variable name bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Applying non-trivial code augmentations, such as changing variable names to vulnerability-related keywords or swapping safe/vulnerable library functions (e.g., using 'strcat' safely or 'strncat' unsafely), to test whether LLMs evaluate actual code logic or rely on naming heuristics.

primary_bias_target: Lexical and semantic code bias (Function and variable name bias)
